ns2:course.label: Frameworks&Methods: Evaluation
ns2:course.description: Frameworks and methods for evaluating actions and plans, including multiattribute, decision analysis, benefit cost, cost revenue, environmental and social indicators, and survey research applied to problems in transportation, land use, real estate, municipal finance, and international development. Focuses on theoretical basis and skills development sufficient to use methods effectively in deciding what to do. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in Urban Planning or consent of instructor.
